question.text: Section XI of the SEBI-prescribed PPM template (Legal, Regulatory and Tax Considerations) for a Cat III AIF is REQUIRED to reference all of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.5 Box 9.1 Section XI expressly lists: Indian Trusts Act 1882 / LLP Act 2008 / Companies Act 2013, SEBI (AIF) Regulations 2012, SEBI ICDR Regulations 2018, SEBI Takeover Code 2011, SEBI PIT Regulations 2015, PMLA 2002, FEMA Schedule 8, Section 10(23FBA)/(23FBB), 194LBB, 115UB, GST, GAAR. The Banking Regulation Act is not part of the standard PPM template. The Trap: A, B, C are verbatim. Option D is plausible-sounding for a fund holding bank deposits but is not a template line item. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the same legal-citation list. III-A / III-C (Compliance) examines the same laws in isolation.
